description: A destination that is dangerous by configuration rather than by identity. libxmljs resolves external entities only when asked, so the same call is a finding with `noent: true` and silence without it -- which is why the parser is described with a condition on the call's own options rather than by name alone. Two of these three routes parse caller-supplied XML perfectly safely.

expected.note: entity resolution is switched on in the call, so the document chooses what the server reads
